q: 'Git aht!' said Liza, pushing him away, not too gently.
1897, W[illiam] Somerset Maugham, Liza of Lambeth, New York, N.Y.: George H[enry] Doran Company, published [1921], →OCLC:

And then came the vile experience of being forced and borne along the street to the police-station. […] "Go it, miss!" cried one. "Kick aht at 'em!" though, indeed, she went now with Christian meekness, resenting only the thrusting policemen's hands.
